title: Cache management
hint: Manage cache keys by module. Refresh rebuilds on the next read; rebuild regenerates immediately.
confirm_clear: Invalidate all cache keys for “:name”? They will be rebuilt on the next read.
empty_keys: No cache keys yet. Keys appear after the application reads the cache.
refreshed: Cache key refreshed. It will be rebuilt on the next read.
confirm_refresh: Refresh “:name”? The current value will be invalidated and rebuilt on the next read.
confirm_rebuild: Rebuild “:name” now? The current cached value will be replaced.
